column3: Directly contrasts the dead with the living and adds unawareness of resurrection.
Places giving life, causing death, and return within one divine sequence.
Adds reviving the dead as an attribute of divine guardianship; the water-revival parallel remains secondary.
Qualifies the apparent dead/alive division by naming a living state for those killed.

Supplies the immediately preceding earth-as-receptacle claim that 77:26 specifies.

Makes death followed by renewed life an explicit ordered sequence.
Keeps the nearby promised-event frame, without specifying the living and dead.
